content.text:
I fixed the bug. `should_retry()` in `anthrouter/http_util.py` had its 429 check inverted. It retried a 429 only when the upstream gave no timing guidance, so a 429 carrying `retry-after-ms: 1500` went straight back to the client. It now retries when guidance is present, and `retry_delay()` then sleeps for that delay.

The fix is one line: `parse_retry_after(resp) is None` became `parse_retry_after(resp) is not None`.

I ran the 165 tests matching `retry`, `http_util` or `transport`, and they pass. The full suite didn't finish within the 120-second command timeout and moved to the background, so I haven't seen a full-suite result. I didn't add a new test for the 429 case.
